correctness.rationale: The source identifies membership in \(\mathcal F_k\) with a repeated eigenvalue \(d_k\) of \(D-xx^{\mathsf T}\). Interlacing forces that repeat into slots \(k-1\) and \(k\), excluding adjacent focal indices. Conversely, every nonconsecutive index set is realized by an explicit interlacing target spectrum. The residues \(p_\mu(d_i)/p_D'(d_i)\) are nonnegative, and the determinant lemma reconstructs a real rank-one vector with exactly that spectrum. The complementary block has nullity at most one, so each repeat is exactly double. The source's four-dimensional example is checked exactly.

value.rationale: The source introduces an all-dimensional repeated-eigenvalue locus as a union of focal quadrics but leaves their mutual incidence undescribed. The theorem gives a complete natural classification: every and only nonconsecutive index pattern occurs, the maximal simultaneous degeneracy is \(\lfloor n/2\rfloor\), and all indexed multiple intersections are counted by \(\binom{n-r}{r}\). This is a structural invariant of the newly introduced focal discriminant rather than an arbitrary numerical specialization.
